description: Effective identity prompt for {provider?} (default_provider when omitted): operator override when set, else provider-declared; null when absent.

request_schema.description: Input of the `router::system_prompt::get` iii function. Unknown fields (e.g. the engine-injected `_caller_worker_id`) are ignored.
request_schema.title: SystemPromptGetRequest

response_schema.description: Output of `router::system_prompt::get`: the effective identity prompt for the resolved provider — operator override (config slice `system_prompt`, when set) → provider-declared → null. Null also when the provider is unknown or no provider resolves; callers treat null as "use your own default prompt".
response_schema.title: SystemPromptGetResponse
